progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ak3 and dwells most on G in Daramad-e Aval. The line peaks at Bb3 (227.6 Hz) at 0:30.4. It closes on the tonic (G3 → G3 → Ak3 → Bb3 → Ak3 → G3).
